checks.human_reference: Surviving title fragments: Elesh Norn, Mothe … Machines. The E and M at torn edges are partially visible, so variants omitting those boundary letters are accepted. The missing r of Mother and the word of cannot be supplied from knowledge of the card.
The front card reads Legendary Creature — Phyrexian Praetor; the rotated card reads Creature — Phyrexian Chimera. Both subtype phrases are required.
Johan Grenier is readable on the rotated card border. Other card artist credits are missing or obscured. Nokar in the rear card’s flavor text is not an artist credit.
